🎥🩸: Simon Says (2026)

A group of friends gathers to celebrate a milestone birthday, but the festivities are cut short when an enigmatic performer takes control of the party with a chilling game of “Simon Says.” Each command grows more terrifying than the last, forcing the guests to choose between obedience and a gruesome fate.

As the night’s deadly challenges escalate, paranoia spreads through the room and survival instincts push everyone to their limits. With no clear way to escape, every decision could cost someone their life, making trust just as dangerous as defiance.

Combining over-the-top gore, tense suspense, and wickedly dark humor, Simon Says transforms a familiar childhood game into a brutal horror experience where only the smartest—or luckiest—stand a chance.

Simon Says is out now on Tubi.
